tools.name: diagram_find
tools.description: Lists this account's diagrams, most recently changed first, with id, key, title and latest revision. query matches the title, key or brief, ignoring case.

tools.name: diagram_get
tools.description: Reads a saved diagram by id or key. The default outline is a header (id, title, revision, time, hash), the brief, recent versions, one element per line nested by container, and edges as 'id: from -> to'. view 'dsp' returns the scene JSON; 'mermaid' returns Mermaid to edit and send back to diagram_ed

tools.name: diagram_validate
tools.description: Checks a DSP scene or Mermaid text without saving it. Returns ok, errors and warnings, each with a code, the element when there is one, and a one-line fix.

tools.name: diagram_create
tools.description: Saves a new diagram from a DSP scene or Mermaid text and returns its id, revision 1, content hash and chain hash. key is your stable name for it, unique in the account: repeating a create with the same key and content returns the existing diagram, not a copy. brief stores context for the next agent.

tools.name: diagram_edit
tools.description: Changes a saved diagram as a new revision; old revisions are kept. Give baseRevision (the revision you last read), a one-line message, and ops (typed operations, https://zindex.ai/schemas/ops.schema.json), mermaid (the whole diagram edited from view mermaid; only differences apply), restoreRevision

tools.name: diagram_render
tools.description: Returns SVG and PNG links to a version of a saved diagram, not the image, with its hashes and engine version. A published diagram's links are permanent, with url for its page; others last 7 days. preview adds a PNG for you. scene or mermaid instead of id previews an unsaved diagram.

tools.name: diagram_history
tools.description: Lists a diagram's versions, newest first, with time, client, message, chain hash and counts of elements added, changed and removed. compare, with from and to as revision numbers or dates, returns what changed between two versions instead.

tools.name: diagram_delete
tools.description: Deletes a diagram with all its versions. It can be restored for 24 hours with undo; after that it is gone. Asks the user to confirm.

tools.name: diagram_share
tools.description: publish makes a diagram readable by anyone at its link; unpublish makes it private. link makes a share link showing its images, not its scene, to anyone who has it; unlink revokes them all. report sends one version to Zindex support. feedback sends Zindex staff a bug, docs (the docs and engine disag

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: diagram_edit · Private data: diagram_share · Public sink: diagram_get, diagram_share · Destructive: diagram_create, diagram_delete.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: diagram_edit · Private data: diagram_share · Public sink: diagram_get, diagram_share · Destructive: diagram_create, diagram_delete

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
